app.label: MPA - Pokemon TCG Pocket Assistant
app.title: MPA: Pokemon TCG Pocket Assistant
controller.android.label: Android Emulator
controller.android.description: MuMu Emulator is recommended. Keep a portrait layout close to 720x1280 and make sure ADB is available.
resource.base.label: Base Resource
resource.base.description: Default Pokemon TCG Pocket resources, recognition templates, and task pipelines.
task.daily_routine.label: Daily Routine
task.daily_routine.description: Start the game, then try gifts, free packs, Wonder Pick, shop freebies, and mission rewards.
task.startup.label: Start And Return Home
task.startup.description: Start Pokemon TCG Pocket, handle title screen and notification popups, then return to Home.
task.stop.label: Stop Game
task.account_bootstrap.label: Login / Account Check
task.account_bootstrap.description: Only locates login and account-linking screens. Third-party passwords, verification codes, and authorization prompts must be handled manually.
task.gacha.label: Open Packs
task.gacha.description: Open free booster packs. The current flow is basic and still needs expansion pack and language hardening.
task.wonder_pick.label: Wonder Pick
task.wonder_pick.description: Enter Wonder Pick and choose available targets. This is currently a skeleton flow.
task.claim_gifts.label: Claim Gifts
task.claim_gifts.description: Claim uncollected and unexpired Gifts. This is currently a skeleton flow.
task.shop_free.label: Shop Freebies
task.shop_free.description: Check daily free shop items, event exchanges, and premium freebies. This is currently a skeleton flow.
task.claim_missions.label: Claim Mission Rewards
task.claim_missions.description: Claim daily, event, and premium mission rewards. This is currently a skeleton flow.
task.solo_battle.label: Solo Battle
task.solo_battle.description: Enter Solo Battle. Future work can automate rewards, surrender loops, or basic battle strategy.
task.versus_battle.label: Versus Battle
task.versus_battle.description: Enter Versus, Ranked, or Private Match. Versus automation should be conservative around reconnects and strategy.
task.share_card.label: Share Card
task.share_card.description: Use Social Hub Share to send a card to a friend. The feature unlocks after 14 days and recipients have daily limits.
task.trade_card.label: Trade Card
task.trade_card.description: Use Social Hub Trade with friends. The feature unlocks after 14 days and only one trade can be active at a time.
